settings.title: Card terminal
settings.intro: With a card terminal connected, the cashier sends the amount to the device with one button and the customer only swipes the card; the receipt prints after approval.
settings.mode_local: Local bridge on the cashier PC
settings.mode_local_hint: The cashier's browser talks directly to the bridge program on this same computer (127.0.0.1). Suited to a cloud server; the bridge program must be running on the cashier PC.
settings.mode_server_hint: The application server itself connects to the bridge/device. It only works when the server sits in the shop network (LAN or VPN); only private addresses (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x, loopback) are accepted.
settings.unit: Amount unit sent to the device
settings.unit_example: For 1,000 Toman the device receives {{n}}. Set the unit as the device/bridge documentation says; a wrong unit makes the amount 10 times too large or too small.
settings.save_first: Save your changes first, then test the connection.
settings.test_ok_local: This computer's browser can reach the bridge.
settings.test_unreachable: Could not connect. Is the bridge/device on, and are the address and port right?
settings.test_not_private: This address is not private and is refused for security.
settings.test_dns: The device name could not be resolved.
settings.readonly: Only the owner or a manager can change the card terminal settings.
settings.load_failed: Could not load the card terminal settings.
settings.err_host: The address is invalid or not private.
settings.err_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
settings.err_timeout: The time must be between 15 and 300 seconds.

checkout.action: Pay with card terminal and print receipt
checkout.hint: The amount appears on the terminal and the customer only swipes the card; the receipt prints automatically after approval.
checkout.sent: The amount was sent to the device. Ask the customer to swipe the card.
checkout.unpaid_note: The order is still unpaid and no payment receipt was issued.

failure.declined: The card was declined (for example insufficient funds).
failure.timeout: The device timed out; no card was swiped.
failure.unreachable: Could not connect to the terminal and nothing was sent. Check that the device/bridge program is on and the settings are right.
failure.failed: The terminal bridge refused the request.
failure.lost: No answer from the server; check the order's payment status in the report.
failure.disabled: The card terminal is not enabled for this business.
failure.order_not_payable: This order can no longer be paid (already paid or cancelled).
failure.server_error: Internal error; check the payment status.

checkout.unknown_text: The amount was sent to the device but no clear answer came back. Look at the device screen/slip before doing anything. The amount is never re-sent automatically.
checkout.mark_paid: It was paid (record manually with trace number)
checkout.trace_label: Trace number on the device slip
checkout.trace_required: Enter the trace number from the device slip.
checkout.status_pending: No clear result from the device yet; look at the device screen/slip.
